title: Rosemary Luxe – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Rosemary Luxe a stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo that comfortably sleeps 8 and places you steps from everything you love about Rosemary Beach. Perfectly positioned in Lofts East at Barrett Square, this coastal escape offers unbeatable walkability to restaurants, boutiques, events, and 4 community pools—all within minutes. Spend quiet mornings enjoying coffee on the furnished balconies, and sun-soaked afternoons strolling to the beach—just a 4-minute walk away.

Inside, this single-level, sunlit condo provides a relaxed, comfortable setting for a beach getaway. Tile floors in the entry, kitchen, and dining area make post-beach clean-up a breeze. The well-equipped kitchen features high-end appliances and overlooks the main living space, creating a central gathering spot for the group. Enjoy casual meals at the 4-seat breakfast bar or a sit-down dinner at the adjacent dining table. A stacked washer and dryer in the kitchen closet makes it easy to refresh beach towels and swimsuits.

The living area offers rich hardwood floors, a 65" Smart TV, 2 cozy armchairs, and a spacious sectional—perfect for unwinding after a day in the sun. When it’s time to rest, guests can choose between two serene bedrooms. The primary suite includes a king bed, 50" TV, private bathroom, access to a private balcony, and a built-in twin-over-twin bunk—ideal for families. On the opposite side of the condo, a second bedroom features a king bed, Smart TV, private bathroom, and its own private balcony.

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
